issues.display_title: Issue #1951: PayPal Downgrade: align path with SUBSCRIBE (webhook-first + SSE)
issues.main_description_html:
Context & Problem Statement

Previously, PayPal subscription downgrades relied on client-side execution via POST /paypal/subscriptions/capture (DowngradeHandler.php). If a user closes the browser, refreshes, or loses internet connection immediately after approving the revision in PayPal's popup, GoThru's database is never updated, leading to desynchronized subscription states and billing discrepancies.

This task migrates PayPal downgrade orchestration to a resilient Webhook-First pattern, making PayPal webhooks the single source of truth for database mutations, fully aligned with the existing SUBSCRIBE and UPGRADE flows.

Related Frontend Issue: GoThruMedia/gothru-dashboard#4332

Scope of Work & Acceptance Criteria

  • Persist Downgrade Intent (CreateSubscription.php):
    • After a successful PayPal subscription revision call (/v1/billing/subscriptions/{id}/revise), store downgrade intent metadata in Redis Toronto: paypal:sub_intent:{subscriptionId} with a 24-hour TTL.
    • Include user_id, plan, target_plan_code, target_plan_id, and is_photo_studio in the payload.
    • Update Redis binding (PaypalSubscriptionBindingHelper) to map the subscription to the new plan.
  • Process Webhook Events (DowngradeIntentProcessor.php):
    • Route BILLING.SUBSCRIPTION.UPDATED and BILLING.SUBSCRIPTION.ACTIVATED webhook events in HandlePaypalWebhook.php to DowngradeIntentProcessor.
    • Implement a distributed Redis lock (paypal:sub_downgrade_lock:{subscriptionId}, TTL 120s) to prevent concurrent execution from duplicate webhooks.
    • Enforce attestation checks: subscription status must strictly be ACTIVE, and PayPal plan_id must match target_plan_id.
    • Validate that $subscriptionId matches the user's active recurring_profile to prevent stale intent replay if the user switched to an Upgrade.
  • Database Scheduling & Status Emission:
    • Idempotently schedule the plan downgrade in tableUnsubscribes (unsubscribe_type = '3', effective at next_billing_time).
    • Emit status active (amount: 0.0) to Redis key paypal:sub_status:{subscriptionId} (TTL 1h) for SSE stream consumption, then delete the intent and release lock.
  • Payment Isolation & Idempotent Capture Fallback:
    • Decouple downgrade processing from PaymentSaleCompletedHandler.php to prevent swallowing recurring renewal payments and invoices.
    • Maintain legacy DowngradeHandler.php as an idempotent fallback that checks for existing DB entries and returns a clean HTTP 200 OK.

Result

Implementation Proof

  • Pull Request: #1979 (base: main)
  • Commits:
    • a078cbecb (Initial webhook-first downgrade implementation)
    • 3fcefbeae (Hardened security, idempotency, and edge-case handling post-review)
  • Core Files Changed:
    • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Paypal/Webhook/DowngradeIntentProcessor.php
    • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Paypal/Subscription/Subscription/CreateSubscription.php
    • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Paypal/Webhook/HandlePaypalWebhook.php
    • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Paypal/Webhook/PaymentSaleCompletedHandler.php
    • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Paypal/Subscription/Subscription/Capture/Actions/DowngradeHandler.php
    • tests/Http/Controllers/Payment/Paypal/DowngradeIntentProcessorTest.php

Key Post-Review Hardenings

  1. Removed finally return override in DowngradeHandler.php so idempotent early-returns preserve HTTP 200 OK.
  2. Added change_plan_to = '1' filter for Photo Studio idempotency check in both DowngradeHandler and DowngradeIntentProcessor.
  3. Removed DowngradeIntentProcessor from PaymentSaleCompletedHandler to prevent swallowing recurring renewal payments.
  4. Enforced strict validation: required PayPal status === 'ACTIVE' and plan_id === target_plan_id to fail closed if a user abandons revision modal.
  5. Guarded against stale intent replay: validated that $subscriptionId matches the user's active recurring_profile.
  6. Corrected Predis 2.0 lock syntax: switched to $redis->set($lockKey, '1', 'EX', $ttlSeconds, 'NX').

Testing Results

  • Automated Unit Tests:
    • tests/Http/Controllers/Payment/Paypal/DowngradeIntentProcessorTest.php: 13/13 tests passed (23 assertions, 100%)
      • test_returns_unhandled_when_no_subscription_id
      • test_returns_unhandled_when_no_intent_in_redis
      • test_returns_unhandled_when_action_is_not_downgrade
      • test_idempotent_when_regular_downgrade_already_recorded_in_unsubscribes
      • test_idempotent_when_lock_is_busy
      • test_handles_user_not_found_gracefully
      • test_successfully_finalizes_photo_studio_downgrade_via_webhook
      • test_successfully_finalizes_downgrade_via_webhook
      • test_handle_paypal_webhook_routes_billing_subscription_updated_to_downgrade_processor
      • test_handle_paypal_webhook_routes_billing_subscription_activated_to_downgrade_processor
      • test_drops_stale_downgrade_intent_when_active_recurring_profile_mismatches
      • test_rejects_downgrade_when_paypal_subscription_is_not_active
      • test_rejects_downgrade_when_paypal_plan_id_mismatches_target_plan
    • tests/Http/Controllers/Payment/Paypal/UpgradeIntentProcessorTest.php: 8/8 tests passed (15 assertions, 100%)
    • tests/Unit/PaypalWebhookVerificationTest.php: 8/8 tests passed (25 assertions, 100%)

issues.display_title: Issue #1952: PayPal Buy-Storage (space addon): align path with SUBSCRIBE (webhook-first + SSE)
issues.main_description_html:
Context

Buy-storage (space addon) is a cancel-and-create subscription flow with proration credit (SpaceAddonHelper, BuyStorageHandler), still driven by the browser capture call.

Goal: make the PayPal buy-storage path identical to the SUBSCRIBE path.

Backend checklist (GoThru-API-New)

  • CreateSubscription::handleBuyStorage() — persist a Redis intent (action=buy-storage, user_id, addon plan, quota)
  • Webhook side: PAYMENT.SALE.COMPLETED recognizes the buy-storage intent → execute BuyStorageHandler finalization (storage quota allocation, cancel old storage subscription) idempotently
  • Write Redis status active → SSE triggered; keep capture endpoint (action=buy-storage) as fallback with idempotency guards
  • Keep net_subtotal calculation aligned between create (CreateSubscription) and finalization (BuyStorageHandler) — first-cycle charge must match the proration computed at create time

Frontend checklist (gothru-dashboard)

  • Tracked separately in frontend issue GoThruMedia/gothru-dashboard#4334 (Board #91)

Acceptance criteria

  • No capture request from the browser for buy-storage
  • Storage quota increases right after the webhook; SSE confirms success; idempotent against webhook retries

Result

  • Pull Request: #1982
  • Key Commits:
    • 148753ce9 — feat(payment): align PayPal buy-storage with webhook-first flow and SSE (#1952)
    • 7216c997f — fix(payment): harden PayPal buy-storage webhook error handling and capture idempotency
  • Key Files Modified/Added:
    • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Paypal/Webhook/BuyStorageIntentProcessor.php
    • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Paypal/Subscription/Subscription/CreateSubscription.php
    • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Paypal/Subscription/Subscription/Capture/Actions/BuyStorageHandler.php
    • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Paypal/Webhook/PaymentSaleCompletedHandler.php
    • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Paypal/Webhook/HandlePaypalWebhook.php
    • tests/Http/Controllers/Payment/Paypal/BuyStorageIntentProcessorTest.php
  • Verification & Test Output:
    • vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Http/Controllers/Payment/Paypal/BuyStorageIntentProcessorTest.php — 14/14 tests passed (100%), 23 assertions.
    • artifacts/review-paypal-buy-storage-findings.html — interactive race condition verification report.
    • Live Verification (2026-09-30): User 50214 (muhamad.rifky.dev@gmail.com), storage addon Level 1 (agency_1) purchased. New PayPal sub I-1DRJDVXNMDBH (ACTIVE, last payment $30.08, plan P-662468699X284501WNF3LSUA), previous sub I-M4F78HNS7HL9 cancelled (CANCELLED). DB updated: users.space_addon = "1", users.space_addon_plan = "space_addon_1", user_extra_data.recurring_profile = I-1DRJDVXNMDBH. cc_purchase row 165238 recorded ($30.08, product 18). Redis status emitted active, intent consumed cleanly.

issues.display_title: Issue #1983: [API Provider] Implement Internal Endpoint GET /internal/users/{uuid}/virtual-tours with Keycloak Service Auth
issues.main_description_html:
Upstream References

  • Parent Epic: GoThruMedia/gothru-sso#9 (Epic: GoThru App-to-App Data Exchange Integration)
  • Parent Task: GoThruMedia/gothru-sso#12 (Task 3: Implement Provider Capabilities)

1. Overview & Goal

Enable GoThru-API-New to act as a secure Data Provider by exposing an internal endpoint that serves virtual tours from hosted_tours.tours to other GoThru services (such as Panorra Backend, Villume, etc.) on behalf of an authenticated user identified by their Keycloak UUID (keycloak_sub).

The internal route must be protected using OAuth2 Keycloak Service Account tokens (client_credentials) with route-level authorization and idempotent JIT user provisioning.

2. Endpoint Specification

  • HTTP Method & Path:
    • GET /internal/users/{uuid}/virtual-tours
    • (Alias: GET /v1/internal/users/{uuid}/virtual-tours)
  • Query Parameters:
    • search (string, optional): Case-insensitive keyword filter matching tour_name or tour_key.
    • page (integer, default: 1): Active page number.
    • per_page (integer, default: 20, max: 100): Number of tour records per page.
  • Headers:
    • Authorization: Bearer <keycloak-service-account-token>
    • Accept: application/json

3. Technical Requirements

A. Keycloak Service Auth Middleware (KeycloakServiceAuthMiddleware)

  1. Extract Bearer token from Authorization header. If missing, return 401 Unauthorized.
  2. Verify RS256 token signature against Keycloak JWKS (cached in local memory/Redis without network calls on hot-path).
  3. Validate claims:
    • iss: matches configured Keycloak realm URL.
    • aud: matches provider API audience contract (gothru-api).
    • exp: token must not be expired (accounting for clock skew).
    • nbf: token must be active.
  4. Verify caller authorization:
    • Extract caller identifier from azp or client_id (e.g. panorra-service, villume-service).
    • Enforce route-aware permission checking (e.g., caller must have gothru.tours.read permission).
    • If caller is not in allowlist or lacks required permission, return 403 Forbidden without touching the database.

B. Request Validation & Identity Resolution

  1. Validate {uuid} parameter against RFC 4122 UUID syntax regex. Return 400 Bad Request if malformed.
  2. Resolve user in database connection gothru_mod, table users by matching keycloak_sub = :uuid.
  3. Idempotent JIT Provisioning:
    • If user does not exist in gothru_mod.users, create a minimal user record linked to keycloak_sub using atomic SQL (INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE) to guarantee concurrency safety.
    • Newly provisioned users immediately yield an empty result ({ data: [], pagination: { total: 0, ... } }).

C. Data Retrieval (hosted_tours.tours)

  1. Query table tours on database connection hosted_tours where user_id = :local_user_id and deactivated = '0'.
  2. Apply search filter if provided: tour_name LIKE %search% OR tour_key LIKE %search%.
  3. Select all schema properties from hosted_tours.tours, explicitly omitting internal user_id for external security.
  4. Order results by creation_date DESC and apply pagination offset/limit.

D. Response Contract

  • 200 OK with JSON envelope { data: [...], pagination: { total, page, per_page, total_pages } }.
  • 200 OK with empty data array { data: [], pagination: { total: 0, ... } } when no tours exist or user is newly JIT-provisioned (MUST NEVER return 404).
  • 400 Bad Request when {uuid} format is invalid.
  • 401 Unauthorized when token is missing, expired, or invalid.
  • 403 Forbidden when caller service is unauthorized or lacks route permission.

4. Planned Deliverables

  • app/Http/Middleware/KeycloakServiceAuthMiddleware.php: Token validation, JWKS caching & allowlist authorization.
  • routes/v1/internal_virtual_tours.php: Dedicated internal route group.
  • bootstrap/app.php: Middleware registration & route inclusion.
  • app/Repositories/Internal/InternalVirtualTourRepository.php: Multi-DB logic, atomic JIT, pagination, keyword search & schema sanitization.
  • app/Http/Controllers/Internal/GetUserVirtualToursInternalController.php: Request validation & query handling.
  • tests/Http/Controllers/Internal/GetUserVirtualToursInternalControllerTest.php: Complete unit & feature tests.

5. Acceptance Criteria

  • Unauthenticated requests return 401 Unauthorized.
  • Authenticated requests from unapproved azp clients return 403 Forbidden.
  • Malformed UUID parameters return 400 Bad Request.
  • Existing users with published tours return 200 OK with JSON envelope and pagination.
  • Existing users with zero tours return 200 OK with { data: [], pagination: { total: 0, ... } }.
  • Unknown valid Keycloak UUIDs are JIT-provisioned in gothru_mod.users and return 200 OK.
  • All unit and feature tests pass cleanly.

Result

  • Pull Requests:
    • Base Provider PR: #1984 (Merged into main)
    • Search & Pagination PR: #1985 (Merged into main)
  • Key Commits:
    • 726214e72 — Initial provider endpoint implementation
    • 427df1a8c — Search and pagination support
    • 363c70def — Return all columns from hosted_tours.tours
    • b9244290b — Omit internal user_id from exposed payload
  • Files Implemented & Modified:
    • app/Http/Middleware/KeycloakServiceAuthMiddleware.php
    • app/Repositories/Internal/InternalVirtualTourRepository.php
    • app/Http/Controllers/Internal/GetUserVirtualToursInternalController.php
    • routes/v1/internal_virtual_tours.php
    • app/Helpers/Auth/KeycloakTokenHelper.php
    • bootstrap/app.php
    • tests/Http/Middleware/KeycloakServiceAuthMiddlewareTest.php
    • tests/Repositories/Internal/InternalVirtualTourRepositoryTest.php
    • tests/Http/Controllers/Internal/GetUserVirtualToursInternalControllerTest.php
  • Test Suite Pass Rates:
    • KeycloakServiceAuthMiddlewareTest.php: 13/13 passed (100%), 42 assertions.
    • InternalVirtualTourRepositoryTest.php: 4/4 passed (100%), 12 assertions.
    • GetUserVirtualToursInternalControllerTest.php: 7/7 passed (100%), 17 assertions.
    • Total: 24/24 tests passed (100%), 71 assertions.
  • Live Verification Data (2026-09-30):

      • Keyword search: search=Gym (returned 2 matching tours: Gym Fit Forme).
      • Schema: 37 columns returned per tour item; internal user_id safely excluded.
